name: sema-intro-video
description: 10-second animated SEMA intro built with Remotion

scripts.render:glass: remotion render SemaGlassWide out/sema-glass-wide.mp4 --codec=h264 && remotion render SemaGlass out/sema-glass.mp4 --codec=h264 && remotion render SemaGlassVertical out/sema-glass-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:vertical && npm run render:sunrise && npm run render:sunrise:vertical && npm run render:swirl && npm run render:swirl:vertical && npm run render:glass
